name: Crashing Waves
source:
Litongxi is dreaming while awake. Her eyes drift in and out of the present and past, old and new connections flit in and out. She has been able to keep going, but for how longer can she bear it?

[From [url=https://lavishen.itch.io/crashing-waves]itch.io[/url]]
